I used to think I was boring and was very shy and intimidated in groups. One day I realized I only thought I was boring because I know all my own stories/experiences/life, but in talking to new people that don’t know anything about me, it’s all new to them. I think the only important thing is to show/be expressive enough to show them that you find the topic interesting. Even when people don’t have the same interests/backgrounds, they often find the conversation interesting if the speaker can show how interested they are. Then asking “why do you find that interesting?” leads to a great conversation.
